construction.note: The chord-sized inner circle, 150° star lines, inking and square tile follow Samira Mian’s twelve-fold rosette lesson. The project records a line-for-line comparison with her pictures.
construction.changes: The app groups the work into 11 steps, including explicit intersection marks. This audit checked the written construction and saved source page; the video and every intermediate picture were not compared again.

credits.creator: Samira Mian
credits.note: The construction (the inner circle from one chord, the star lines joining its points 150° apart, the inking, and the square and hexagonal tiles) follows her tutorial; the wording is ours. She names the source as the minbar of the al-Maridani mosque, Cairo.

given.A: Any point to the right of O. OA is the radius of the first circle.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A. Keep this compass size for the next steps.
Draw a circle with centre A through O. Draw a circle with centre G through O, where the line crosses the first circle on the left.
Draw a vertical line through O. It crosses the first circle at D and K. Draw a circle with centre D through O. Draw a circle with centre K through O.

Draw a straight line through B and H. Draw a straight line through C and J. Draw a straight line through E and L. Draw a straight line through F and M. B, C, E, F, H, J, L and M are where the four new circles cross the first circle. The first circle is now cut into twelve.

Draw a straight line through A and B. Draw a straight line through B and C. Draw a straight line through C and D. Draw a straight line through D and E. Draw a straight line through E and F. Draw a straight line through F and G. Draw a straight line through G and H. Draw a straight line through H and J. Draw a straight line through J and K. Draw a straight line through K and L. Draw a straight line through L and M. Draw a straight line through M and A. The twelve lines outline the rosette. They run on past its corners.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: B, C, E, F, H, J, L and M are where the four new circles cross the first circle. Draw a straight line through A and B. Draw a straight line through B and C. Draw a straight line through C and D. Draw a straight line through D and E. Draw a straight line through E and F. Draw a straight line through F and G. Draw a straight line through G and H. Draw a straight line through H and J. Draw a straight line through J and K. Draw a straight line through K and L. Draw a straight line through L and M. Draw a straight line through M and A. The twelve lines outline the rosette. They run on past its corners.

steps.text: Draw the line through O that halves the angle AOB. Draw the line through O that halves the angle BOC. Draw the line through O that halves the angle COD. Draw the line through O that halves the angle DOE. Draw the line through O that halves the angle EOF. Draw the line through O that halves the angle FOG. There is now a line through O every 15°.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw the line through O that halves the angle AOB. Draw the line through O that halves the angle BOC. Draw the line through O that halves the angle COD. Draw the line through O that halves the angle DOE. Draw the line through O that halves the angle EOF. Draw the line through O that halves the angle FOG. These lines run through O at 15°, 45°, 75° and so on.

steps.text: Draw a straight line through G and N. N is where the line that halves the angle COD crosses the first circle. The line crosses the vertical line at T. Draw a circle with centre O through T. This inner circle carries the star.
Mark S1 to S12, where the inner circle crosses the lines through O at 15°, 45°, 75° and so on.

Draw a straight line through S1 and S6. Draw a straight line through S2 and S7. Draw a straight line through S3 and S8. Draw a straight line through S4 and S9. Draw a straight line through S5 and S10. Draw a straight line through S6 and S11. Draw a straight line through S7 and S12. Draw a straight line through S8 and S1. Draw a straight line through S9 and S2. Draw a straight line through S10 and S3. Draw a straight line through S11 and S4. Draw a straight line through S12 and S5. The twelve lines make a twelve-pointed star.
Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a vertical line through G. Draw a horizontal line through D. Draw a horizontal line through K. Join V1, V2, V3 and V4, where these lines cross, to mark the tile.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Join V1, V2, V3 and V4 to mark the square tile. Its corners are crossings already on the board.

steps.text: Mark each point where the ink turns.

ink.text: Ink each star line from the outline in to its first crossing. Ink the outline from the star lines, through each corner, out to the edge of the tile.

parts.text: Ink from U1 to X2. Ink from U2 to X12. These are two star lines, from the outline in to their first crossing.
Ink the same two lines at each of the other eleven corners of the outline. Tick “Also ink the copies round the centre” to ink them all at once.
Ink the outline at A: from U24 through A to U1.
Ink the outline at B: from U2 through B to W3, and from W1 through B to U3. Each line runs on to the edge of the tile.
Ink the outline at the other corners, C to M, in the same way. Tick “Also ink the copies round the centre” to ink them all at once.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square tile side by side. The outline lines run on into the next tiles. They close the shapes between the rosettes.
